blue.purpose: Owns whole regions: the search band, primary button, active states, badges.

blue-press.purpose: Hover/press of blue fills; blue text on Blue Wash (6.02:1).

ink.purpose: The stamp, demo-marker outlines, and the one reversed plate per screen (doctor page WhatsApp contact bar).

sky.purpose: Focus rings and selection only. White on it fails (2.33:1).

ground.purpose: Page ground the slips lie on; chips, unavailable stub, row hover.

slip.purpose: Slips, groups, top bar, tab bar, tiles, search field; white text on blue and ink.

wash.purpose: Tinted fill for labels, active tabs, quiet buttons, the stub WhatsApp action, row icons.

line.purpose: 1px dividers, field borders, top bar and tab bar edges.

tear.purpose: The 1.5px dashed tear line on slips and the profile seal.

text-2.purpose: Secondary text: roles, addresses, cell labels, sources, inactive tabs.

danger-wash.purpose: Fill behind Danger text. Literal value in globals.css, not a custom property.

ok-wash.purpose: Fill behind OK text. Literal value in globals.css, not a custom property.

display.purpose: Screen titles, search band title, the doctor's name on the profile slip, admin stat numbers.

title.purpose: Slip names, shelf and section titles, empty-state titles.

body.purpose: Running text and inputs; tabular numerals; prose capped at 44rem.

body-strong.purpose: Buttons, contact plate, active top tab (700); fact values and FAQ questions (500).

label.purpose: Meta, stub cells, labels, chips, tab labels, breadcrumbs, footer.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: Resting slips, groups, FAQ items, empty states, round buttons.

shadows.name: slip-hover
shadows.purpose: Slip hover under a fine pointer only.

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: Floating tab bar and the contact plate.

shadows.name: field-on-blue
shadows.purpose: The search field lifting off the blue band.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: All keyboard focus; fields use 0 0 0 3px rgba(20, 180, 255, 0.35) with a blue border.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Spring-like settle for press feedback and the FAQ plus-icon rotation.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Scale-on-press: round button 0.92, heart 0.88, tab 0.94, tile and stub action 0.96, button and plate 0.97, slip 0.985.

motion.name: stamp-press
motion.value: keyframes from { scale: 1.14; opacity: 0.2; filter: blur(1.5px) } to { scale: 1; opacity: 1; filter: blur(0) }; animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: entry 10% entry 70%
motion.purpose: The stamp presses onto the slip as it scrolls into view; only with animation-timeline support and prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; the stamp is static.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Gutter 1.5rem; band content capped at 44rem; shelves become minmax(21rem, 1fr); tiles go to 16px; doctor page centres at 44rem; slip addresses truncate to one line.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: The three tabs move into the top bar; floating tab bar and top-bar heart hidden; foot padding 3rem.

openDecisions.name: dark-mode
openDecisions.note: Project rules list dark mode as a design aim; owner specified white and light gray. Build ships color-scheme: light only. Owner to decide.

openDecisions.name: perforation-notches
openDecisions.note: Notches on the slip's tear line were considered and deferred; the tear is a dashed line only.

outOfSystem.note: Static intro page built with a different kit (design-taste-frontend); not part of this system.

narrative.overview:
Every doctor in PANIVO is a white appointment slip lying on a light-gray counter, and every slip carries a round ink-blue verification stamp holding the date the facts were last checked. The stamp is the system's one ornament and its whole argument: trust is shown next to the facts it vouches for, not claimed in a headline. Everything else stays quiet so the stamp and the WhatsApp action are the two things a patient sees.

The world is Arabic-first and right-to-left, set in one sturdy sans (Readex Pro) at exactly four sizes, in Modern Standard Arabic. Brand blue does not sprinkle; it owns whole regions (the search band, active tabs, the primary button). Stamp ink is used as ink, and once per screen as a reversed plate. Density follows the delivery-app reference the owner named: large cards, swipeable shelves, very few words. The interface is light only for now: white and light gray around the three owner-fixed brand blues.

The category default this world refuses is a white list of interchangeable doctor cards with star ratings and stock portraits. There are no ratings, no rank numbers and no portraits that the doctor did not approve. The separate static intro page (`public/intro/index.html`) was built with a different kit and is outside this system; do not take values from it.
keyCharacteristics: White slips (18px corners, soft ink-tinted shadow) on a counter-gray ground.
A dashed tear line separates the facts from the stub of fixed cells and the WhatsApp action.
One round ink-blue stamp per slip, rotated -8°, pressing in as it scrolls into view.
Brand blue owns regions; sky blue appears only as focus and selection.
One face, four sizes, three weights (400, 500, 700); tabular numerals everywhere.
Floating pill tab bar on phones and tablets; from 64rem the three tabs move into the top bar.
Logical (inline/block) properties throughout, so the layout is native RTL.

rules.name: The Three Blues, Three Jobs Rule
rules.body: Clinic Signal Blue owns regions, Stamp Ink is ink, Focus Sky is focus. A blue that is doing another blue's job is wrong.

rules.name: The Sky Is Not a Fill Rule
rules.body: Focus Sky never carries text and never fills a button, badge or band: white on it is 2.33:1. It exists only as focus rings and selection.

rules.name: The One Plate Rule
rules.body: At most one reversed Stamp Ink plate per screen, and on the public site that plate is the doctor page's WhatsApp contact bar. Demo markers are outlined in ink, never filled.

rules.name: The Logo-Only Gradient Rule
rules.body: Gradients exist only inside the supplied logo artwork in `public/brand/`. Every surface in the interface is a flat colour.

rules.name: The Four Sizes Rule
rules.body: Only `--fs-s` 13px, `--fs-m` 16px, `--fs-l` 20px and `--fs-xl` 28px exist. A new role takes one of the four sizes and a weight; it never adds a fifth size.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Readex Pro is the only family, self-hosted with the site; no external font service, no second family for numbers or display.

rules.name: The Latin-Date Rule
rules.body: Dates are written YYYY/MM/DD in Latin digits, in an LTR run (`dir="ltr"`), as on Saudi forms, so stamp, stub and source line read identically.

rules.name: The Ink Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted with Stamp Ink (rgba 0, 26, 137), soft and negative-spread. No grey-black shadows, no hard offsets.

rules.name: The Two Heights Rule
rules.body: A surface either rests (slip shadow) or floats (float shadow). Bars attached to an edge stay flat with a hairline.

dos: **Do** keep blue in whole regions (band, primary button, active state) and use Pressed Blue (#0052cc) for any blue text on Blue Wash.
**Do** put the consent stamp on every slip and the source plus last-checked date beside every fact.
**Do** keep the slip's anatomy: facts and stamp above a 1.5px dashed tear line, fixed stub cells «الخبرة» | «آخر تحقق», WhatsApp action at the end of the stub.
**Do** use only the four sizes (13, 16, 20, 28px) and the weights 400, 500 and 700 of Readex Pro.
**Do** keep the stamp static under reduced motion, and keep press feedback to small scales on a 120ms `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`.
**Do** keep touch targets at 2.75rem or larger and write every edge with logical properties.
**Do** mark demo profiles with the outlined Stamp Ink label and the «تجريبي» notice strip.
donts: **Don't** put white text on Focus Sky (#14b4ff, 2.33:1) or use it for anything but focus and selection.
**Don't** add a second reversed Stamp Ink plate to a screen, and don't fill demo markers.
**Don't** use gradients anywhere outside the supplied logo artwork, and don't recolour, stretch, shadow or add effects to the logo or wordmark.
**Don't** show star ratings, rating numbers, review counts, rank numbers, "top" ribbons or any visual that implies an order of merit; public order is set by the owner and never described.
**Don't** use stock photos of doctors or any portrait without the doctor's recorded approval.
**Don't** add ornament beyond the stamp: no illustrations, patterns, badges or decorative icons on slips.
**Don't** add a fifth type size or a second typeface.
**Don't** ship a dark theme until the owner decides; the system is light only today.
